description: ResolveIT error-code registry. Generated from ErrorCodeRegistry; do not edit by hand. Regenerate: cd backend; .\mvnw.cmd test "-Dtest=ErrorCodeContractTest" "-DupdateContracts=true"

errorCodes.title: This request couldn't be verified
errorCodes.why: The security token that protects your session was missing or didn't match, so ResolveIT refused the change.
errorCodes.nextStep: Reload the page and try again. If it keeps happening, log out and log in again.

errorCodes.title: You don't have access to this
errorCodes.why: Your role doesn't allow this action or page in ResolveIT.
errorCodes.nextStep: If you need it for your work, ask your ResolveIT administrator. Otherwise go back to the dashboard.

errorCodes.title: Email or password is incorrect
errorCodes.why: The email address and password you entered don't match an active ResolveIT account.
errorCodes.nextStep: Check both and try again. After 5 failed attempts in a row, login is blocked for 15 minutes. If you forgot your password, contact your ResolveIT administrator.

errorCodes.title: Login is temporarily blocked
errorCodes.why: There were 5 failed login attempts in a row for this account, so login is blocked for security for about {retryAfterMinutes} more minute(s).
errorCodes.nextStep: Wait until the block ends, then log in with the correct password. If you don't remember it, contact your ResolveIT administrator.

errorCodes.title: You're not logged in
errorCodes.why: Your session has ended or is no longer valid, for example after you logged out, after 8 hours, or because your account was deactivated.
errorCodes.nextStep: Log in again with your email address and password.

errorCodes.title: Something went wrong on our side
errorCodes.why: ResolveIT couldn't complete the request because of an unexpected error.
errorCodes.nextStep: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, contact the ResolveIT administrator and quote the reference shown under Details.

errorCodes.title: This action isn't available here
errorCodes.nextStep: Reload the page and try again. If it keeps happening, report it to the ResolveIT administrator.

errorCodes.title: This request can't be processed
errorCodes.why: The request to {path} uses a format or option that ResolveIT doesn't support.
errorCodes.nextStep: Reload the page and try again. If it keeps happening, report it to the ResolveIT administrator.

errorCodes.title: This page or item doesn't exist
errorCodes.why: Nothing is available at {path}. The link may be outdated or mistyped.
errorCodes.nextStep: Check the address, or go back to the dashboard and open the item from there.

errorCodes.title: Some information is missing or invalid
errorCodes.why: The request could not be accepted because these fields are missing or invalid: {fields}.
errorCodes.nextStep: Correct the highlighted fields and submit again.
